name: Estimated Landed Cost Report
query:
WITH
landed_cost_breakdown AS (
    SELECT elc.name AS item_group, elc.estimated_landed_cost_account, elc.exchange_rate, elcd.expense_name, elcd.expense_type, elcd.value
    FROM `tabEstimated Landed Cost Detail` elcd
    INNER JOIN `tabEstimated Landed Cost` elc ON elcd.parent = elc.name
),
purchase_invoice_detail AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT i.item_group, pi.cntr_vol, pi.pod, pi.grand_total, pi.base_grand_total,
           IF(pi.incoterm = 'FOB', pi.cntr_vol * pi.freight_per_cntr, 0) AS freight
    FROM `tabPurchase Invoice Item` pii
    INNER JOIN `tabPurchase Invoice` pi ON pii.parent = pi.name
    INNER JOIN `tabItem` i ON pii.item_code = i.name
    WHERE pii.docstatus = 1 AND pi.is_return = 0 AND pi.update_stock = 0
      AND pi.name = %(purchase_invoice)s
      AND pi.name NOT IN (SELECT purchase_invoice FROM `tabPurchase Receipt Item` WHERE docstatus = 1 AND qty > 0 AND purchase_invoice IS NOT NULL)
),
estimated_landed_cost AS (
    SELECT ROUND((SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN lcbd.expense_type = 'Percentage-wise' AND lcbd.expense_name = 'Customs Duties' THEN pid.grand_total * lcbd.exchange_rate * lcbd.value + pid.grand_total * lcbd.exchange_rate * lcbd.value * 0.03 + pid.freight * 3.76 * lcbd.value
            WHEN lcbd.expense_type = 'Percentage-wise' AND lcbd.expense_name != 'Customs Duties' THEN pid.grand_total * lcbd.exchange_rate * lcbd.value
            WHEN lcbd.expense_type = 'Container-wise' AND lcbd.expense_name = 'DMM to JED Transport' AND pid.pod = 'Dammam' THEN pid.cntr_vol * lcbd.value
            WHEN lcbd.expense_type = 'Container-wise' AND lcbd.expense_name = 'Transportation' AND pid.pod != 'Dammam' THEN pid.cntr_vol * lcbd.value
            WHEN lcbd.expense_type = 'Container-wise' AND lcbd.expense_name NOT IN ('DMM to JED Transport', 'Transportation') THEN pid.cntr_vol * lcbd.value
            WHEN lcbd.expense_type = 'Shipment-wise' THEN lcbd.value
            ELSE 0
        END) + MAX(pid.freight) * 3.76) * 1.03, 2) / pid.base_grand_total AS prorata
    FROM landed_cost_breakdown lcbd
    INNER JOIN purchase_invoice_detail pid ON lcbd.item_group = pid.item_group
),
purchase_invoice_item AS (
    SELECT i.item_group, pii.item_code, i.item_name, i.brand, pii.production_year, ts.sorting_code,
        SUM(pii.qty) AS qty,
        SUM((pii.base_net_amount + pii.item_tax_amount) * (1 + elc.prorata)) AS total_cost_amount
    FROM `tabPurchase Invoice Item` pii
    INNER JOIN `tabPurchase Invoice` pi ON pii.parent = pi.name
    INNER JOIN `tabItem` i ON pii.item_code = i.name
    INNER JOIN `tabTire Size` ts ON i.tire_size = ts.name
    CROSS JOIN estimated_landed_cost elc
    WHERE pii.docstatus = 1 AND pi.is_return = 0 AND pi.update_stock = 0
      AND pi.name = %(purchase_invoice)s
      AND pi.name NOT IN (SELECT purchase_invoice FROM `tabPurchase Receipt Item` WHERE docstatus = 1 AND qty > 0 AND purchase_invoice IS NOT NULL)
    GROUP BY pii.item_code, pii.production_year
),
stock_detail AS (
    SELECT item_code, production_year,
        SUM(actual_qty) AS bal_qty,
        (SUM(SUM(stock_value_difference)) OVER (PARTITION BY item_code) / SUM(SUM(actual_qty)) OVER (PARTITION BY item_code)) * SUM(actual_qty) AS bal_value
    FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry`
    WHERE is_cancelled = 0
    GROUP BY item_code, production_year
),
item_price AS (
    SELECT item_code, production_year, price_list_rate
    FROM `tabItem Price`
    WHERE selling = 1
      AND price_list IN (
          SELECT value FROM `tabSingles`
          WHERE doctype = 'Selling Settings' AND field = 'selling_price_list'
      )
)
SELECT pii.item_code,
    pii.item_name,
    pii.brand,
    pii.item_group,
    pii.production_year,
    pii.qty AS invoice_qty,
    pii.total_cost_amount / pii.qty AS invoice_cost_rate,
    IFNULL(sd.bal_qty, 0) AS current_stock_qty,
    IFNULL(sd.bal_value, 0) / IFNULL(sd.bal_qty, 0) AS current_cost_rate,
    pii.qty + IFNULL(sd.bal_qty, 0) AS future_stock_qty,
    (pii.total_cost_amount + IFNULL(sd.bal_value, 0)) / (pii.qty + IFNULL(sd.bal_qty, 0)) AS future_cost_rate,
    ip.price_list_rate,
    CONCAT(ROUND((ip.price_list_rate - pii.total_cost_amount / pii.qty) / ip.price_list_rate * 100, 1), '%%') AS invoice_gpm,
    CONCAT(ROUND((ip.price_list_rate - IFNULL(sd.bal_value, 0) / IFNULL(sd.bal_qty, 0)) / ip.price_list_rate * 100, 1), '%%') AS current_gpm,
    CONCAT(ROUND((ip.price_list_rate - (pii.total_cost_amount + IFNULL(sd.bal_value, 0)) / (pii.qty + IFNULL(sd.bal_qty, 0))) / ip.price_list_rate * 100, 1), '%%') AS future_gpm
FROM purchase_invoice_item pii
LEFT JOIN stock_detail sd ON pii.item_code = sd.item_code AND pii.production_year = sd.production_year
LEFT JOIN item_price ip ON pii.item_code = ip.item_code AND pii.production_year = ip.production_year
